to build stronger communities by offering opportunities for fulfillment and an active, healthy and
engaged life for all. Description The YMCAs of Quebec are a charitable organization whose mission
is to build stronger communities by providing opportunities for development and active, healthy

living committed to all. Its ten YMCA centers, its international language school, its ski school, its
Residence, its Kanawana YMCA Camp and its 43 service points across the province, are visited
each year by more than 130,000 people. The first YMCA in America Nord was founded in Montreal
in November 1851. The YMCAs of Quebec are part of a network Canadian which has 50 YMCA
associations. For more information, visit our site Internet www.ymcaquebec.org, our Facebook
pages facebook.com/ymcaquebec or Twitter twitter.com/YMCAQuebec.

Organization 2: Parents involved in early childhood - PEP URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/hippyquebec/ Website:
http://www.parentsengages.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Head office 5964
avenue Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, bureau 206, Montréal QC H4A 1N1 5144841471, ext. 230 Opening
hours SCHEDULE From Monday to Friday by appointment. Flexible, according to the schedules
defined between the speakers at home and parents. Social networks Contacts (1) MARIE-JOSÉE

PERREAULT Director general 5144841471 extension: 230 Communicate with this contact Mission
Parents committed to early childhood has the mission of offering, developing and supporting,
particularly in Quebec, primarily home-based programs aimed at improving the aptitude of
immigrant parents and from disadvantaged backgrounds to strengthen their children's ability to
learn at a young age as well as than to better prepare them for school. Description Program

Activities are offered at each visit, to families' homes, 30 weeks per year by home workers. Home
visits are made every week or every two weeks, depending on the needs of the parents. The
activities, both fun and educational, are focused on the development overall health of the child.
Parents become familiar with the observation and development of skills through play and daily
activities at home. The speaker brings a new book in the family, so that parent and child enjoy

exploring a diversity of books and establish a reading routine at home. Thus, the parent is made
aware of the importance of exposing your child to reading to support them in their language
development in particular. The targeted skills work on language, the development of fine motor
skills and overall, memory and listening skills, as well as emotional development and coordination
oculo-manual. Additionally, parents can discuss parenting techniques with the speaker and we also

do SEO. Group activities Group activities group on different subjects and outings are organized for
parents.

Organization 4: Baobab Family URL: https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/baobabfamilial/
Website: http://www.baobabfamilial.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Head office
599-6767 ch. Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal QC H3S 2T6 514-734-4097 Opening hours SCHEDULE
Monday 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. Tuesday 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 6 p.m. Wednesday 9 a.m. – 12
p.m. and 1 p.m. – 6 p.m. Thursday 9 a.m. – 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 6 p.m. Social networks Mission Le

Baobab Familial is a family home, a living environment, a gathering place that promotes mutual aid,
exchange and the feeling of belonging to one's environment. We welcome and support families by
enriching their family and community life. Our work is oriented towards families in a spirit of respect,
integrity and collaboration. Description The Family Baobab offers various services intended for
families in the Côte-des-neiges district: Welcome, listening, referral and support; homework help;

community daycare; respite at home;; teen group; sports activities for women and girls; activities for
fathers; sharing cafes and thematic workshops; workshops on the rights and responsibilities of
children, on the migratory journey and on parenting skills; etc. The Baobab Familial also offers all
kinds of activities social and cultural character. Our outings allow our families to discover Quebec
(beach, apples, sugar shacks, etc.), collective kitchens and community suppers are as much
opportunity to meet and share.

Organization 5: Yaldei Shashuim Development Center URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/centre-de-developpement-yaldei-shashuim/
Website: https://www.centreyaldei.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details
5170 rue Van Horne, Montréal QC H3W 1J6 514 279-3666 514 278-3666 Opening hours
SCHEDULE Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Mission Yaldei is a developmental center and
school dedicated to helping children reach their full potential. Through therapies, educational

programs and clinical services, we provide comprehensive support to children with various
disorders, helping them learn, grow and thrive within their community. Description Donald
Development Center Berman Yaldei is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping children
develop their full potential. Founded in 1998 in Boisbriand, Quebec, by Menachem and Devorah
Leifer, Yaldei offers range of therapeutic, educational and recreational services for children from

birth to the age of 18. Within Yaldei, a multidisciplinary team including therapists experienced and
educators dedicated to early intervention treatments, therapies individualized education and special
education programs. The center offers clinical services such as clinical diagnosis, early intensive
intervention, ABA therapy, psychology, physiotherapy, phonoaudiology, occupational therapy,
music therapy, art therapy and many others. Yaldei School: education adapted to students

diagnosed with an autism spectrum disorder and mild to severe intellectual disability. Support
programs: toddler group, support school, social and personal skills, day camp. In 2016, Yaldei
moved to a modern 40,000 square foot establishment in Montreal, offering its services to more than
25 schools and helping 276 children each year. Yaldei School offers education in English for
students aged 4 to 16 with moderate to profound intellectual disabilities, autism spectrum disorders

and related physical disabilities. To learn more about the services offered by Yaldei or to request
admission, please contact Chanie Klein at 514-279-3666.

Organization 6: Montreal Center for Learning Disabilities URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/centre-montrealais-pour-les-troubles-dappr weaving/
Website: https://ldmontreal.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 2100
avenue Marlowe, suite 535, Montreal QC H4A 3L5 514 482-7196 Opening hours SCHEDULE by
appointment Mission Our mission at the Montreal Center for Learning Disabilities is to empower

individuals with learning disabilities, providing programs and resources to help them reach their full
potential. We work in collaboration with families, educators and professionals to build an inclusive
and educational future for all. Description Montreal Center for Learning Disabilities About us Since
1966, the Montreal Center for Learning Disabilities Learning Disabilities (CMTA) is dedicated to

improving the lives of people with learning disabilities. We offer a range of programs and services
tailored to unique needs of each individual. Our Services At CMTA, we provide support and
resources for: Parents: Workshops, support groups and positive parenting programs. Children and
youth: Programs like CYBER K.I.D.S., AQUA K.I.D.S. and development of social skills. Adults: Life
skills coaching, career guidance and groups support. Educators and professionals: Ambassador

program, webinars and workshops. Upcoming events Participate in our upcoming events: Annual
fundraiser – evening humor Webinars “Improv for happiness” Conferences for parents Seminars
with guest speakers Contact us If you would like to know more about our programs or get involved,
please contact the Montreal Center for Disorders of Learning. Your support helps us continue to
make a difference in the community.

Organization 7: Pauline-Julien Center URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/centrepaulinejulien/ Website: None Description:
ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 6830, chemin de la Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal QC
H3S 2A8 (514) 736-8105 (514) 736-3526 Mission Provide education programs to quality adults in
Montreal, in order to help members of our community achieve their academic and professional

goals. We are committed to providing an inclusive environment and stimulating that promotes the
personal and professional development of each of our learners. Description The Pauline-Julien
Center, located in Montreal, is an organization community engaged in adult education. Its mission is
to promote access to education for all, by offering programs and services adapted to the needs of
each person. Our team of passionate professionals work daily to support learners in their learning

journey, with an emphasis on academic success and development personal. We believe in the
importance of education as a lever for individual development and social. At the Pauline-Julien
Center, we offer a range of varied services to meet to the diverse needs of our customers. Whether
you want to improve your skills in reading and writing, prepare for a high school equivalency exam
or take a professional training, we are here to support you. We are proud of contribute to adult

education in Montreal and participate in the development of our community. Join us at the
Pauline-Julien Center and together, let's build a future better through education.

Organization 8: Friend Club URL: https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/clubami/ Website:
http://clubami.qc.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 6767 Chemin De
la Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal QC H3S 2T6 514-739-7931 Opening hours SCHEDULE Opening
hours: Monday to Thursday, from 9:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. and from 1 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. We are closed
Monday morning and Friday Networks Social Mission Club Ami is a non-profit community

organization whose mission is to improve the quality of life of people experiencing mental health
problems. Club Ami aims to develop an inclusive living environment by promoting the exchange
and sharing of unique experiences. In addition, the organization encourages freedom of speech,
artistic expression and intellectual while providing a place for participation in local and community
integration. Description Club Ami is located in the Côte-des-Neiges district, in Montreal, and allows

people suffering psychologically to have a space of their own, where it is possible to sharing
moments of respite, a coffee or the exceptional presence of our members. We offer a variety of
group activities: painting workshops, yoga, museum visits, conferences, and more. The speakers
and our director organize the activities, ensure well-being of everyone within the organization and
are available to hear and refer if need.

Organization 9: Marie de France International College URL:

training in a diverse and stimulating environment. Our private establishment offers high-level
education in the fields of education, ranging from neighborhood schools to post-secondary
education. We put a point of honor in offering enriching programs that promote the overall
development of students. The Marie de France International College is distinguished by: A secular

and open approach to cultural diversity Exceptional international openness Educational programs of
quality We are proud to contribute to the education of young Montrealers, by offering them a
stimulating and inclusive learning environment. Join our dynamic school community and open to the
world at the Collège international Marie de France.

Organization 12: English-Montreal School Board URL:

avenue Fielding, Montréal QC H3X 1T4 514 483-7200 Opening hours SCHEDULE Monday to

excellence and the promotion of bilingualism. We aim to prepare students to become engaged and
competent citizens, while promoting cultural and linguistic diversity. Support the holistic
development of each learner, cultivating an inclusive and stimulating learning environment.
Description School board English Montreal The English Montreal School Board (CSEM) offers an
academic program focused on excellence for students at all levels. Being bilingual is a strength,

and the EMSB is committed to offering quality programs in a dynamic and enriching environment.
French programs Within the CSEM, students have the opportunity to follow different French
programs adapted to their needs and level. Whether it's the program bilingual, French immersion or
secondary French programs, the CSEM aims to provide quality teaching to enable students to
become bilingual. Program bilingual Basic French French immersion Heritage language teaching

program (PELO) French, language of instruction French, basic program (FLS) French, enriched
program (FLS-E) Measures to intensify French Services offered Archives and student files
Research projects Annual calendars Upcoming events Stay informed upcoming events organized
by the CSEM by consulting our online calendar. Of open houses, virtual job fairs and other activities
are planned for you allow you to discover our schools and our programs. Join the English School
Board Montreal for quality learning and an enriching educational experience!

Organization 13: Hellenic Community of Greater Montreal - CHGM URL:

Wilderton, Montréal QC H3S 2K8 514-738-2421 514-738-5466 Opening hours SCHEDULE

CENTER 450-681-5952 450-688-1834 HEAD OFFICE 5777, ave Wilderton 514-738-2421
514-738-5466 Mission La Hellenic Community of Greater Montreal serves the Greek population of
the greater region of Montreal (Montreal, Laval and South Shore) since 1906. For more than 100
years, the CHGM has never stopped representing the proud citizens of Quebec of Greek origin,

who settled and continue to settle in the greater Montreal area. The CHGM provides the population
of Greek origin a variety of services: (cid:127) Education (cid:127) Church (cid:127) Culture
(cid:127) Social (cid:127) Sport (cid:127) Volunteering (cid:127) Member services (cid:127) And
much more Our goal is to constantly enrich and unify members of our community, by bringing them
together, meeting their needs and strengthening our ties with other cultural communities in the

Greater Montreal region. Our ancestors built their dream, we preserve our heritage for generations
to come! Description The goals of the Community are to ensure the flourishing of the culture of
population of Greek origin in the Montreal region and in particular: (cid:127) to preserve and
promote the Greek language; (cid:127) to set up works of charity, well-being and education for the
benefit of the population of Greek origin; (cid:127) to preserve and perpetuate the Greek Orthodox

faith and the tradition promulgated by the authority of the Ecumenical Patriarchate of
Constantinople, following the doctrine and faith proclaimed and applied by the Greek Orthodox
Church, and according to ecclesiastical authority and the religious rules designated by this
patriarchy.

Organization 15: Council of Black Educators of Quebec URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/conseil-des-educateurs-noirs-du-quebec/ Website:
https://qbbe.ca/fr Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 5165 rue Sherbrooke
Ouest, office 317, Montréal QC H4A 1T6 514 481-9400 Opening hours SCHEDULE Monday to
Friday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Mission Our mission at the Quebec Board of Black Educators (QBBE)

is to encourage and support the continuous improvement of Quebec's education system, by
providing opportunities equitable educational opportunities for communities of color. We aim to
have a positive impact on social and economic achievements of our students, families and
communities. Description The Quebec Board of Black Educators (QBBE) is a non-profit education
and research institution for-profit organization committed to raising awareness of bias in education

and providing support and academic opportunities to communities of color. Our history: Founded in
1968, the QBBE's mission is to pursue excellence in educational opportunities for
multicultural/intercultural communities. In response to the educational needs of communities
English-speaking black people, the organization was legally registered on December 29, 1971. Our
programs: Elementary programs: Student support, summer courses and online tutorials focused on

early intervention in literacy. Secondary Programs: Support school leading to obtaining a diploma
and pursuing post-secondary studies. Program transition to high school: Preparing students for
secondary school. Our mission: Encourage and support the continuous improvement of the Quebec
education system and distribution fairness of its benefits to communities of color. We offer
education personalized, attractive and quality, aligned with the national curriculum. Clientele

served: More than 50 years after its creation, the QBBE serves multicultural and intercultural
families, primary and secondary students in the French-speaking, English-speaking and private
sectors. At Quebec Board of Black Educators, we are dedicated to providing educational services
of quality for a better future for all. Join us in our mission to promote equity and excellence in
education for black and racialized communities in Quebec.

Organization 16: Deutsche Sprachschule Montréal Center - DSQ URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/deutschesprachschulemontrealcentre/ Website:
http://www.ecolesallemandes.org/montreal-centre Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION
Contact details 4635, chemin Queen Mary, Montréal QC H3W 1W3 450-666-0036 Opening hours
SCHEDULE When? Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 11:40 a.m. How long? 15 weeks. Start: September 8.

End: January 12, 2013 for the 0-3 group years/kindergarten/adults and May 11, 2013 for primary
and secondary students (because Germany only offers subsidies for the school year). Contacts (1)
FRINGS ANDREA Director 450-666-0036 Mission We emphasize learning the German language
directly linked to German-speaking culture and civilization: - Learning through art projects, theater,
music and dance in the context of traditional German festivals. - Learn through extracurricular

activities such as the St. Martin’s Lantern Parade in the month of November, baking Christmas
cookies, Easter egg hunting, etc. Description We continue to offer German courses at all levels
(beginner to advanced) and for everyone ages: – for the first time, we also offer a group for 0-3 year
olds and their parents. While the little ones will have fun with German songs and nursery rhymes,
the parents will be able to participate in discussions on issues related to this age group and

German-speaking context. – a kindergarten group for 3-6 year olds – a group of students from
primary school with German as a familiar language from 7 – 12 years old – a group for pupils from
primary school for which German is a foreign language (7-12 years) – an A2 level group for Ages
13-99 (with 4 credits for high school students) – a beginner group (ages 13 – 99) Make your
Saturday outing an immersion in German: Toddlers with mom/dad in the infant and toddler group,

children between 3-6 years old in kindergarten, students in primary and secondary in children's
groups with German as a familiar language or in the group for those for whom German is a foreign
language and adults, for example, the non-German speaking spouse/friend in adult groups,
depending on their level. We offer family discounts! Welcome also to beginner friends of the
language and culture Germans.

Organization 17: Montreal School of Advanced Business Studies - HEC URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/ecoledeshautesetudescommercialesdemontreal/
Website: http://www.hec.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Coordinates 3000, chemin
de la Côte-Sainte-Catherine, Montreal QC H3T 2A7 514 340-6000 514 340-6411 The email
address of this organization is unknown, please contact them by phone or check their website. This

organization belongs to you? Claim management of this file! Mission Our mission to HEC Montréal
is to train the next generation of internationally renowned management, contributing to the growth
of the company since 1907. We value equity, diversity, inclusion, management sustainable and
responsible for a positive impact in the community. Description HEC Montréal is a French-speaking
university establishment renowned for its teaching programs and its management research. Since

1907, the School has trained the next generation of managers contributing to the growth of society.
The mission of HEC Montréal is to train responsible and competent leaders, while promoting equity,
diversity and inclusion. The establishment is also committed to sustainable and responsible
management, thus reflecting its fundamental values. Rankings: HEC Montreal is among the best
global institutions in terms of university innovation, as evidenced by its recent recognition in the

World University Rankings for Innovation. The HEC Montréal campus is a dynamic place that
regularly hosts events varied. Community members are invited to organize activities and contribute
to the wealth of the campus. Recent events: July 16, 2025: IICADD celebrates its 50th anniversary
with the international cooperative research community. July 15, 2025: Benoit Aubert named
co-editor-in-chief of the Journal of Strategic Information Systems. July 14, 2025: The vision

committed by Dominique Anglade hailed nationally. About HEC Montréal: The establishment
highlights its commitment to generative artificial intelligence, thus demonstrating its desire to
innovate and stay at the forefront of technological advances. HEC Montréal is part of an
international environment, while benefiting from the wealth cultural and academic culture of the city
of Montreal, recognized for its knowledge and dynamism. In In short, HEC Montréal stands out for

its academic excellence, its progressive vision and its involvement in society, making the
establishment a major player in management training in Quebec.

Organization 18: Multiethnic School of Languages and Cultures of Quebec URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/ecole-multiethnique-de-langues-et-de-cultu
res-du-quebec/ Website: https://coursdefrancais.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION
Contact details 3480 boulevard Décarie, 2nd floor, Montreal QC H4A 3J3 514 484-8899 Opening
hours SCHEDULE Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Saturday and Sunday 2:00 p.m. to

6:00 p.m. Mission Our mission at the Multiethnic School of languages and cultures of Quebec
(ÉMULCQ) is to offer free, quality French courses to immigrants, thus promoting their linguistic and
social integration into the community Quebecois. Description Multi-ethnic school of languages and
cultures of Quebec (ÉMULCQ) The Multiethnic School of Languages and Cultures of Quebec
(ÉMULCQ) offers French courses free and part-time since 1991. Our school is recognized for its

excellence in teaching the French language to immigrants in Quebec. About ÉMULCQ Since its
creation, ÉMULCQ actively participates in the Linguistic Integration Program for immigrants from
the Quebec government. Our school has stood out by offering a quality educational environment
that meets the needs of our students and promotes their learning French. We are proud of our
reputation and commitment to our students. Our goal is to help immigrants fully integrate into

society Quebecois by offering them French courses adapted to their needs. Services offered by
ÉMULCQ Free, part-time French courses – Our courses are designed to allow immigrants to learn
French at their own pace. Linguistic integration program for immigrants – ÉMULCQ actively
participates in this government program aimed at facilitate the integration of French-speaking
immigrants in Quebec. How to register For you To register for the next session, please visit the

website quebec.ca. You can also contact for more information about our courses and services. We
are here for you support you in your learning of French and to help you succeed in your integration
into Quebec. Join us today to start your language journey with ÉMULCQ!

decision-makers. It constitutes a summary of free public conferences, files on the myths and
realities surrounding aging, as well as links to other sites dealing with the problems faced by older
people in society. Every year, the OVS organizes Montreal free public conferences intended to

stimulate the exchange of ideas and views between experts and the population. The topics concern
